data.label: DEMO ADAPTER
data.title: Demonstration computed from analytic / published formulas or merged lane-F/G code while the owning lane is not merged; not that lane's output

data.label: NOT AVAILABLE
data.title: Nothing honest to show yet; see the reason

data.label: CERTIFIED
data.title: Every target met by an applicable, independently checked bound

data.label: INFEASIBLE
data.title: Applicable bounds exist but targets cannot be met

data.label: OUT-OF-MODEL
data.title: Request violates the proof's trust/physical model

data.label: UNCERTIFIED
data.title: Missing bound, assumption or independent check

data.label: UNSAFE
data.title: An attack exceeds the claimed bound or targets

data.label: CERTIFIED-NUMERIC
data.title: Numeric bound with rigorous residual accounting

data.label: DIGITIZED-FIGURE
data.title: Read off a published figure; carries digitization error

data.label: MEASURED-LATENCY
data.title: Latency from real measurements

data.label: MODELLED-LATENCY
data.title: Latency from a model (light-cone, queue model); not a measurement

data.label: MONTE-CARLO (lower bound)
data.title: Sampled attack success: a LOWER bound on worst-case attack success, never an upper bound

data.label: NUMERICAL
data.title: Floating-point SDP solver output; not a proof without residual accounting

data.label: PHOTON-EXPERIMENT
data.title: Real recorded photon events with dataset hash

data.label: PUBLISHED-AGGREGATE
data.title: Number quoted from a paper table or text

data.label: THEOREM
data.title: Bound transcribed from a peer-reviewed proof

data.label: QPU
data.title: Actual quantum hardware job with job id

data.label: SIMULATOR-IDEAL
data.title: Noiseless circuit/statevector simulation

data.label: SIMULATOR-NOISY
data.title: Simulation under a declared noise model

data.label: SYNTHETIC
data.title: Generated fixture or hypothetical scenario

data.label: UNCERTIFIED
data.title: No applicable evidence
